item.title: Lesson 99: “Salvation is my only function here.”
item.description: “Salvation is my only function here.” Salvation and forgiveness are the same. They both imply that something has gone wrong; something you need to be saved from or forgiven for; something amiss that needs corrective change, something apart or different from the Will of God.
